name: Gualchos (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and light blue, the white broadest, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gualchos (an angel and a tower above waves on blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Gualchos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Gualchos arms — angel and tower above waves
